title: A Simulation Platform for AUV Fault Recovery: Exploring LLM-Based Diagnostic Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2609.20620v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating beyond reliable communications must recover from failures without human intervention. We investigate an architecture in which conventional deterministic layered control autonomy manages normal operations, while an invokable large language model (LLM) serves as a diagnostic and recovery planner when onboard anomaly detection identifies performance outside expected limits. Because language models are stochastic, rigorous evaluation requires ensemble testing rather than individual demonstrations. We present a closed-loop simulation architecture that couples real-time C vehicle software with a higher-level orchestration layer for physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, language-model interaction, mission file generation, validation, execution, and LLM-judge scoring. translated_title: 一种用于AUV故障恢复的仿真平台：探索基于大语言模型的诊断策略
translated_abstract: 在超出可靠通信范围运行的自主水下航行器（AUV）必须在没有人工干预的情况下从故障中恢复。我们研究了一种架构，其中传统的确定性分层控制自主系统负责管理正常操作，而当机载异常检测发现性能超出预期限制时，可调用的大语言模型（LLM）则充当诊断和恢复规划器。由于语言模型具有随机性，严格的评估需要进行集成测试而非单个演示。我们提出了一种闭环仿真架构，将实时C语言载具软件与更高层的编排层相结合，用于实现基于物理的故障注入、结构化提示、语言模型交互、任务文件生成、验证、执行以及LLM裁判评分。这个我们称之为SPAR（Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery，AUV恢复仿真平台）的框架，支持跨故障实现的评估
tldr: 该论文提出了一个名为SPAR的闭环仿真平台，通过结合物理故障注入、结构化提示与LLM裁判评分，对基于大语言模型的AUV故障诊断与恢复策略进行严格的集成化评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SPAR, a closed-loop simulation platform that evaluates LLM-based diagnostic and recovery strategies for AUVs through physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, and LLM-judge scoring for rigorous ensemble testing.
